title: Shaam ke Baad
body:
Shaam ke baad
Bhaiyyah teri maajaayi ney
Yeh bhi dekha Shaam ke baad
Shaam sey pehlay qatl huva tu
Paani aaya Shaam ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar maqtal jaatey jaatey
Khushboo apni chodd gaye
Maa aankhoun sey choom rahi hai
Qaali jhoola Shaam ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba ko jab yaad kareigi
Shimr tamaachey maareyga
Ho jaaengay khoon mai tarr
Rukhsaar-e-Sakina Shaam ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
Din kay ujaaley may lailaa ney
Hashr kay manzar dekhliye
Noukay sinaa par dekh rahi hai
Chaand ka tukdaa Shaam ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim-o-Akbar aun-o-mohammad
Khana-e-zehra ke thay charaag
Soonay ghar may yaad aayega
Har shehzaada Shaam ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaam-e-ghareebaan ke maaroun ko
Nangay sar dekha jo zaki
Dhaamp raha hai chaadar bunkar
Ghorr andheiraa Shaam ke baad
